message: So, a little while back, I was hosting game night and my friend Mike—bless his heart—got a bit too excited making popcorn in the microwave. You know how it goes; one minute he was laughing, and the next he was convinced the whole place was going up in flames. While we all chuckled at his over-the-top reactions, it reminded me how important it is to have a solid fire safety plan. We checked our smoke alarms afterward and talked about escape routes just to keep things light. Do you have any funny stories about friends panicking in a crisis?
